The '''Teth resistance''' was a movement that fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. It was established before the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] but joined the Alliance after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="LoNH" />
